intro: Onboarding workflow automation helps you reclaim the time you lose to repetitive data entry and status updates. As a customer onboarding specialist, your day is often split between managing complex CRM records and answering the same questions in Slack or email.

blocks.text: Why your onboarding workflow automation feels stuck

You likely operate in a fragmented environment. Your data lives in Salesforce or HubSpot, your project plans reside in Notion or Rocketlane, and your communication happens in Slack and Gmail. Each tool requires a different set of clicks and shortcuts. When you move between these apps, you lose momentum. Onboarding workflow automation is not just about using complex scripts. It is about reducing the friction of your daily Mac tasks.

Specialists often perform manual data entry because they lack a unified way to interact with their stack. You might copy a name from an email, paste it into a CRM, then move to Notion to create a project page. This creates a high risk of error. If you follow your company policy on data, you should always verify the information Lazur points out before you save it to your secure internal systems.
Managing your day with voice commands

Your Mac is a powerful machine, but you are limited by your mouse and keyboard speed. By using voice commands, you can trigger actions without moving your hands away from your current window. Hold the ⌥ ⌘ keys to ask Lazur where a specific setting is in your browser. Lazur will draw a circle around the button, helping you find it instantly.
If you are struggling to find a specific field in a complex web form, ask Lazur to point it out. It saves you from scanning the screen for small labels.
blocks.title: Find form fields faster

blocks.text: Email is the biggest time sink for most specialists. You send the same welcome templates daily. Instead of copying and pasting, use the dictation feature. Hold the fn key to start dictating your response. You can prepare snippets for common questions. This keeps your communication personal but fast.

When you draft in Gmail, try to keep your sentences short. This makes your tone more direct and easier for the customer to read. If you need to check a status in Notion, you can ask Lazur to summarize the page content while you stay in your email tab.
Reducing context switching in your browser

Context switching is the enemy of efficiency. Every time you switch from Chrome to Slack, your brain resets. Try to keep your most used apps in specific desktop spaces. Use ⌃ 1 through ⌃ 4 to jump between them. If you get lost, ask Lazur to guide you to the correct app or tab.

items: Over-automating: Do not automate tasks that require a human touch, like complex conflict resolution.
Ignoring data security: Always ensure your automation tools comply with your company data handling policies.
Lack of documentation: If you create a new workflow, write it down in Notion so your team can use it too.
Assuming tools are integrated: Most tools do not talk to each other. Rely on your own workflow to bridge the gap.

blocks.text: Practical steps for your next onboarding session

Start by auditing your current process. List every task you do for a new customer. Identify the ones that take the most time. If you spend 20 minutes setting up a Notion page, look for ways to use templates. Once you have the template, use voice commands to fill in the placeholders.

You have many deadlines. A new customer might need a follow-up in 3 days. Instead of relying on your memory, use your voice to add tasks to Apple Reminders. Say, 'Remind me to follow up with Acme Corp on Friday morning.' This keeps your tasks out of your head and in your system.

faq.question: Can Lazur automate my entire onboarding process?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a voice assistant that helps you navigate and draft content faster. It does not click buttons or operate other apps for you.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe to use with customer data?
faq.answer: Lazur only listens and looks at your screen when you hold the shortcut. Your data is not stored or used to train AI models.

faq.question: How do I start using Lazur for my daily tasks?
faq.answer: Download the app, open it, and try holding ⌥ ⌘ to ask a question about your current window. You will see how it points out elements and answers your questions.
